en: Color postcard view of a large Gothic-style church with a tall central spire and a red-tiled roof, fronted by a statue on a pedestal in the middle of a landscaped square with flowerbeds and trimmed bushes. Surrounding the square are historic multi-storey buildings with ornate facades and domed roofs. People are walking in the square and cars and a bus are visible on the bordering streets. The scene is taken on a sunny day and looks like a central European city center.
